text: sync: a pull-only request can return a cursor covering rows it did not send

Landed in 6e7afcc. delta reads meta.change_seq FIRST, so the cursor can only lag the rows (over-delivery is idempotent under LWW, under-delivery loses data); explicit-transaction alternatives rejected with reasons in the comment. I re-ran my own two-connection reproduction against the fix: the interleaved write no longer vanishes, the cursor stays below it and the next pull delivers it. Wire contract says clients must tolerate a row arriving twice.
